looks.caption: Decision key at review tier beside the approved image, 01:30 UTC: stamp laid on its side, sheet off square, panel with its line of light

The letter: fibre, lifted corner, shade all round, the mark printed twice and unevenly
The wait display: a grid of round lamps behind smoked glass
